name: session-time-machine
description: /timemachine draws the session as a timeline of prompts, tool calls and turn ends from its own transcript. Press a point and give a new instruction: the mod writes a copy of the transcript cut there under a new session id and gives you the `claude --resume` command that continues it, so you can try the other approach without losing this one. Hooks session.start, command.run, turn.complete and ui.render on Pane.

copyCommand.title: Copy the resume command
copyCommand.description: Copy the `claude --resume` command of a fork to the clipboard

snapshots.title: Snapshot the working tree
snapshots.description: Commit the working tree with a throwaway git index at each point so a fork can restore the files into a worktree

openTerminal.title: Open forks in Terminal
openTerminal.description: macOS: open the forked session in a new Terminal window instead of only copying the command
